source.name: MLB.com press release – Cardinals announce Stifel as club's first jersey patch sponsor
source.note: The club's own announcement of a seven-year agreement starting with the 2023 season. 'to' left null: the term is stated but no reported end year is given. The live page blocks scripted access (403); the quote was verified on the Wayback Machine capture of 7 March 2026.
source.quote: The St. Louis Cardinals today announced that St. Louis-based financial institution Stifel will serve as the club's first-ever official jersey patch partner.

note: Jersey patch, worn on the sleeve.
